description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 3020004314206 GEAR ASSY,BEVEL: Line 0001 Qty 23 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0053 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
